notes: Cycle tracking context for the Coach (docs/cycle-tracking.md §9, docs/coach.md). Only sent when the user turned on Coach access to cycle data. Both platforms embed this file byte-identically.
never_shared: individual day logs older than the history window
header: Cycle tracking (user-logged in Ayuvo; calendar-based estimates, not measurements):
not_available_line: No cycle data is available: the user has not set up cycle tracking, or has turned off Coach access to it.

lines.cycles: Recent cycle lengths (oldest to newest): {lengths} days. Median {median} days, typical range {low}–{high} days, variability {variability}.
lines.no_cycles: Fewer than one full cycle logged so far.
lines.current: Today is cycle day {day}; estimated phase: {phase}.
lines.next: Next period estimated around {date} (range {low} to {high}); this is an estimate.
lines.late: The period is {days} days later than the estimate.
lines.symptoms: Most logged symptoms over the last {cycles} cycles: {list}.
lines.moods: Most logged moods over the last {cycles} cycles: {list}.
lines.pain: Highest pain logged per recent cycle (0–10): {list}.

prompt: - Never diagnose and never name a condition (for example PCOS, endometriosis, thyroid or hormonal disorders) as the cause of a pattern.
- Predictions, the fertile window and ovulation are calendar estimates; always call them estimates and never present them as certain.
- Cycle estimates are not birth control and cannot be used to plan or prevent pregnancy; say so if asked.
- You may summarize patterns in the user's own data and suggest questions to bring to a healthcare professional when a change persists or worries them.
- Use only the cycle data provided; never invent dates, lengths or symptoms.
